PCA_raw_fit.corrected_data: Projected onto original Raw components; not a second PCA fit
PCA_raw_fit.feature_selection: Raw detection >=70% of 39 retained samples and Raw SD>1e-8
PCA_raw_fit.missing_imputation: Each selected protein's Raw median, identical for Raw and Corrected
PCA_raw_fit.centering: Each selected protein's Raw mean after Raw-only missing imputation
